facts.fact: The Médiateur de la République's electronic grievance-register portal had received 52,262 grievances nationwide since October 2023, according to its digitisation director.
facts.system: portail électronique des registres de doléances

facts.fact: The portal serves all administrations and public establishments, with 43,870 accounts created for 21,953 public administrations, the director said.
facts.system: portail électronique des registres de doléances

facts.fact: The mediator's office said 40,145 of 52,262 grievances were handled and closed, 76.81 per cent, between October 2023 and 22 April 2024.
